negative_prompt: 3 COCO categories absent from all annotations of each image, fixed in selection.json
matching: same category; confidence-descending greedy one-to-one IoU>=0.50; unmatched detections with crowd IoA>=0.50 ignored
scope: only predeclared scene-group vocabulary is evaluated; no mAP; no novel-class claim
timing: first detector construction, first detect call; then 1 warm-up + 5 repeats on first image in each group, .25, same vocabulary
bootstrap: 2000 stratified image resamples, 4 images per group, seed 20261022, percentile 95% CI
